statement: For the 3-out-of-5 picture-hanging problem in the free group F_5 as defined in source.md and interpreted in problem.md, no admissible element has reduced length at most 18. Hence L(3,5) >= 20. The explicit independently checked length-26 element also gives L(3,5) <= 26, so the certified window is 20 <= L(3,5) <= 26. This is a strict subsidiary bound and does not determine the exact value requested by the original problem.
contribution: The result supplies an exact, independently checkable finite exclusion through length 18: all 12 possible positive-even multiplicity patterns are encoded without heuristic pruning, their archived CNFs regenerate exactly, their Glucose3 DRUP traces reproduce byte-for-byte, and every trace passes an independent drat-trim replay. Together with a directly verified length-26 construction, this narrows the previously sourced exact-minimum problem to 20, 22, 24, or 26 while making no exhaustive priority claim.
